lcc_original: 挪亞就進樓船，也帶他的兒子、妻子、和兒媳婦、一同進去，要躱避洪流的水。
notes: WAH0413 (אֶל, into) absorbed onto 進 — LCC has no separate directional particle before 樓船; 進 in LCC already carries the full 'enter into' sense
WAH0854 (אִתּוֹ, with him) attached to 帶 as the primary expression of the comitative; 一同進去 is LCC's stylistic expansion clause with no direct Hebrew counterpart and receives no additional SN
洪流<WH03999>的水<WH04325> reverses UNV tag order to match LCC's genitive structure: 洪流 = flood/mabbul (H3999), 水 = waters (H4325)
兒子<WH01121>、妻子<WH0802> word order is reversed from UNV (妻 before 兒子) but SNs follow LCC's own word order
